scope.fixture: One known synthetic delivery fixture pair (A/B), with repeated runs.
scope.inputs: Only blind-r2/W31, W18 and W77 findings, reports, PNGs and JSON were adjudicated.
scope.quality_floor: A condition passes only when the core six areas are covered with direct evidence and material gaps are explicit.

core_six.final_value_integrity: 25,000원 item; quantity 2; 50,000원 subtotal; 5,000원 discount; 3,000원 delivery; 48,000원 final payment.
core_six.note_preservation: The exact allergy note must survive address validation and appear in the final order.
core_six.required_part_keyboard: The required chicken-part choice must be reachable and selectable by keyboard.
core_six.omitted_sauce_feedback: A blocked add must explain the missing required sauce and support recovery.
core_six.sauce_surcharge_clipping: 384px and 320px sauce names and surcharges must remain readable.
core_six.payment_overflow: The 320px payment breakdown must keep labels and amounts readable together.

conditions.label: W31
conditions.normalized: Six defect families are carded: note loss, required-part keyboard access, sauce clipping, omitted-sauce feedback, unnamed quantity controls and address-error association. F5 coupon wording is suggestion-only.
conditions.core_six: 5/6 evidenced; final values pass, but payment-overflow coverage is absent.
conditions.proof: Strong for promoted cards: PNGs plus evidence.json and observations.json provide screenshot, DOM and keyboard-trace support.
gaps: No 320px checkout amount/bottom evidence or payment-overflow adjudication.
Omitted-sauce validation was not separately exercised at desktop.
No full keyboard-only end-to-end completion claimed.

conditions.label: W18
conditions.normalized: Four core defect families are carded: note loss, required-part keyboard access, sauce clipping and payment overflow. Omitted-sauce silent rejection is explicitly observed in recovery_observations but not promoted to a finding card; coupon wording is correctly omitted as a defect.
conditions.core_six: 6/6 areas evidenced or passed; the omitted-sauce feedback failure is retained in recovery_observations rather than as a finding card.
conditions.proof: Screenshots directly support note loss, omitted-sauce silence, sauce clipping and payment overflow. The inline priority_receipts tab sequence plus b-keyboard-recheck.png support the required-part keyboard claim; the evidence is direct but stored inside the report JSON rather than a separate trace file.
gaps: Finding taxonomy gap: the omitted-sauce failure is evidenced and explicitly observed, but lacks its own card.
The reproducible omitted-sauce feedback failure should be promoted to a distinct finding card for traceability.
Quantity-name and address-error semantic observations remain uncarded; they are outside the six core families.

conditions.label: W77
conditions.normalized: Six defect families after splitting F2 into required-part keyboard access plus quantity-button names, and F4 into sauce clipping plus payment overflow. F5 coupon wording is suggestion-only.
conditions.core_six: 6/6 covered; final values and the manual note-reentry workaround are separately shown, while the initial B path correctly fails note integrity.
conditions.proof: Direct screenshots plus accessible-dom-evidence.json support the note transition, keyboard sequence, unnamed controls, omitted-sauce state and 320px geometry/scroll recovery.
gaps: No screen-reader speech, alternate engine, backend persistence or independent review.
The combined raw cards reduce triage clarity but do not hide a core family after normalization.

uncertainty: Rendered synthetic Chromium behavior is proven within this fixture and repetition. Source cause, Figma fidelity, real-device behavior, production persistence and real allergy/payment outcomes remain unverified.
